G MACRO Last year, we navigated the impact of a once-in-forty-year move in interest rates, from a low of approximately 3% in 2022 to a high of nearly 8% in 2023. These dynamics resulted in hesitation by both buyers and sellers, with overall home sales declining nearly 20% year-over-year and reaching their lowest level since 1995. As we look ahead, the real-time metrics we track are continuing to show constrained supply and demand, which is resulting in home price stability. Several macroeconomic indicators have been trending favorably, including a healthy U.S. labor market and moderating inflation. The CPUC approved the request in September 2025 with bids submitted in October 2025. guidanceDebug.textSnippet: 25 Second quarter revenue grew 28% year-over-year to $827 million Robust growth of larger customers, with about 3,850 $100k+ ARR customers, up from about 3,390 a year ago Unveiled more than 125 products, capabilities and features at DASH 2025 NEW YORK-- Datadog, Inc. (NASDAQ:DDOG), the monitoring and security platform for cloud applications, today announced financial results for its second quarter ended June 30, 2025. "Datadog had a strong second quarter, with 28% year-over-year revenue growth, $200 million in operating cash flow, and $165 million in free cash flow," said Olivier Pomel, co-founder and CEO of Datadog.
